title: Supply of Furniture items for the inspection quarters of Chennai Lighthouse under Chennai directorate-Reg.
summary: Notice inviting quotation for supplying a teak wood single cot, a coir mattress and a teak wood double cot to the inspection quarters of Chennai Lighthouse.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffar Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Chennai Lighthouse, No. 12, Kamarajar Salai, Marina Beach, Mylapore, Chennai
sites.work: Supply of furniture for inspection quarters

scope.item: Supply of Teak Wood Single Cot (6 1/4' x 3'), inclusive of loading, unloading, packing, forwarding, freight charges upto Chennai Lighthouse
Supply of Coir Mattress (reputed make) (6 1/4' x 3' x 4" thickness) for single cot, inclusive of loading, unloading, packing, forwarding, freight charges upto Chennai Lighthouse
Supply of Teak Wood Double Cot (6 1/4' x 5'), inclusive of loading, unloading, packing, forwarding, freight charges upto Chennai Lighthouse

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value (PBG/FDR), valid 60 days beyond warranty period; released after 1 year warranty
money.notes: Payment on final account basis after satisfactory supply; no extra payment beyond quoted rate.

period.completion: 15 days from date of supply order
period.warranty: 1 year against manufacturing defects for all wooden items

eligibility: At least one similar work >= Rs 73,760, or two each >= Rs 46,100, or three each >= Rs 36,880 during last seven years ending 31 March 2025; similar work = supply of office furniture items in Central Govt./State Govt./public listed/PSUs/reputed firms
GST registration certificate and PAN details
Non-blacklisted affidavit on firm's letter head for last 03 years
Valid registration and office address in Tamilnadu/Puducherry (MSME certificate, business registration certificate)
Detailed technical specifications of items as per Annexure A
Completion certificates from clients not below rank of Manager/Assistant Executive Engineer/Administrative officer with purchase order/GeM CRAC
specs: Teak wood single cot 6.25' x 3' with coir mattress 6.25' x 3' x 4"; teak wood double cot 6.25' x 5' (carved headboard); designs as per photos in Annexure C
Stage inspection by DLL Chennai representative of raw material before polishing/varnishing and of built quality before supply
notes: Sealed quotations to reach office by 17/02/2026 15:00, opened 18/02/2026 10:00. No estimate printed; similar-work thresholds imply about Rs 92,200. Delivery PIN printed as 6000044 (sic).
